title: gatewatch: governance title claims automated workflow changes absent from diff
description: Evidence (Article VIII): commit a98349927ddcf6304521228086f58b3dd89a1a72; git show --stat reports only docs/CONSTITUTION.md (142 insertions), and the full diff is docs/CONSTITUTION.md lines 1-142.
